bibliographic.title: For Gregg
bibliographic.author: Leon Barillaro
bibliographic.description:
You are a manager of a team of very important business analysts. You have been given the task of working with your company's newly-purchased project management software to review the performance of your direct report, Gregg Pendleton. There's just one problem: Gregg died last week.

This short interactive fiction game comes with the following CONTENT WARNINGS: corporate indifference, gaslighting, mentions of death and suicide.
